_comment: Tier-2 for febio::multiphasic#3. <sol>1</sol> inside a 'prescribed concentration' BC gives 'tag "sol" (line N) : unrecognized tag'; an undeclared species gives 'tag "dof" (line N) : invalid value: c9'. Each message is required ABSENT from the other run, so neither half can be satisfied by the wrong trigger. Positive control: the shipped template, unmodified, which reaches normal termination — so the message is attributable to the single thing that was changed. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'concentration_dof_child=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
